About the Position

EMBL's international PhD programme recruits students into research groups across its European sites. The Winter 2027 selection cycle includes an online application, academic references and later interview stages. Applicants can apply before finishing their qualifying degree if it will be completed before the start.

Research Areas

  • Molecular biology
  • Bioinformatics
  • Computational biology

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD studentship
Stipend / salaryDoctoral fellowship support; exact amount not verified

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Academic preparationDegree completed, or expected before starting, that qualifies the applicant for PhD entry in its country of award.
Further conditionsAll nationalities; reference deadline 14 October; host site depends on research group.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round12 October 2026, 23:59 CET
LocationGermany / United Kingdom / France / Spain / Italy

How to Apply

  1. Create an account in the EMBL online application portal and complete the application fields.
  2. Arrange at least two academic reference letters through the programme’s process.
  3. Submit by 12 October 2026 and ensure references arrive by 14 October 2026; emailed applications are not accepted.

About European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL)

EMBL is an intergovernmental life sciences laboratory with research sites across Europe. Its international PhD programme recruits students into research groups and offers training across experimental and computational molecular biology.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Open the application portal

Official Link

https://e-recruitment.embl.de/applicant-phd/login

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.
